flows.title: V2 evaluation cycle
flows.summary: Jádro V2 engine. Vyhodnotí všechny objectives nad aktuálním inputem, určí stav uzlů, naplánuje granty rewardů a appendne události do append-only ledgeru.
flows.diagram:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant UI as ProgressionEngineProvider participant Eng as ProgressionEngine participant Cat as Objective + Node
Catalog participant Eval as Evaluators
(objective, node, planner) participant Repo as HybridProgression
EngineRepository participant Isar as Isar
(ledger) participant FS as Firestore
(eager, unawaited) participant CB as Cosmetic Bridge UI->>Eng: evaluate(input, reason) Eng->>Cat: load definitions Eng->>Eval: ObjectiveEvaluator.evaluateAll(input) Eval-->>Eng: ObjectiveOutcome[] Eng->>Eval: NodeResolver.resolveAll(outcomes, ledgerSnapshot) Eval-->>Eng: NodeState[] (locked / available / completed / claimed) Eng->>Eval: RewardGrantPlanner.plan(newly completed nodes) Eval-->>Eng: LedgerEvent[] (skip events s existujícím eventKey) Eng->>Repo: appendEvents(events) Repo->>Isar: write (deterministic eventKey) Repo-)FS: unawaited push (fire-and-forget) Eng->>CB: forwardCosmeticGrants(events) CB->>UI: notify CosmeticsProvider Eng-->>UI: ProgressionResolutionResult

flows.title: Player rebuild z Journalu (Phase 5)
flows.summary: Source-of-truth pro Player.level + Player.totalXp je Journal (RewardGrantEvent stream). Po každém ledger appendu nebo auth notify se Player přepočte přes statickou Player.fromJournal factory. PlayerProvider lazy-cache potlačí redundant rebuilds — identical(rewardGrants) iterable + identical chrome → no fold, no resolve, no notify.
flows.diagram:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant Eng as ProgressionEngineProvider participant Repo as HybridProgressionEngineRepository participant Isar participant Proxy as ChangeNotifierProxyProvider2
(main.dart) participant PP as PlayerProvider participant PFJ as Player.fromJournal
(static factory) participant LC as LevelCurve participant UI as UI consumer
(Phase 6+) Eng->>Repo: appendEvents([RewardGrantEvent]) Repo->>Isar: write (deterministic eventKey) Repo-->>Eng: ok Eng->>Eng: refresh _ledger (new LedgerSnapshot instance) Eng->>Eng: notifyListeners() Eng->>Proxy: notify Proxy->>PP: applySnapshot(uid, rewardGrants: ledger.rewardGrants,
levelCurve, joinedAt, chrome) alt cache hit (identical rewardGrants + chrome) PP-->>Proxy: return (no recompute, no notify) else cache miss PP->>PFJ: Player.fromJournal(uid, rewardGrants, levelCurve, ...) PFJ->>PFJ: Player.totalXpFromGrants(rewardGrants)
(O(n) fold, xp-kind only) PFJ->>LC: resolve(totalXp) LC-->>PFJ: LevelResolution PFJ-->>PP: Player alt new Player != cached PP->>PP: cache + notifyListeners() PP-->>UI: Player snapshot else value-equal PP-->>Proxy: cache only (no notify) end end Note over Eng,PFJ: ProgressionEngineProvider.EngineProfile getter
volá stejný Player.totalXpFromGrants — single XP-sum,
žádný drift mezi engine input a Player UI.

flows.title: Write-through cloud sync
flows.summary: Každý lokální append do Isaru se zrcadlí do Firestoru fire-and-forget pushem. Cloud failure nikdy neblokuje lokální commit — events jsou immutable s deterministickým eventKey, takže retry je idempotentní.
flows.diagram:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant Eng as ProgressionEngine participant Hybrid as HybridProgressionEngineRepository participant Isar participant GW as FirestoreProgressionEngineGateway participant FS as Firestore Eng->>Hybrid: appendEvents(events) Hybrid->>Isar: append (per collection) Isar-->>Hybrid: ok Note over Hybrid: synchronní část hotová — UI dostane výsledek hned Hybrid-)GW: unawaited push GW->>FS: set() per event
(idempotent, doc ID je eventKey) alt cloud failure FS--xGW: error GW->>GW: AppLog.sync.warn(err) end

flows.title: Pull-and-merge na login
flows.summary: První non-null uid po sign-inu spustí pullAndMerge: stáhne všechny Firestore subkolekce, vrátí jejich události do Isaru a re-evaluate engine. Cosmetic bridge re-aplikuje historické unlocky pro fresh install / druhé zařízení.
flows.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Auth as AuthProvider
    participant Prov as ProgressionEngineProvider
    participant Hybrid as HybridProgressionEngineRepository
    participant GW as Gateway
    participant FS as Firestore
    participant Isar
    participant Eng as ProgressionEngine
    participant CB as Cosmetic Bridge

    Auth-->>Prov: authStateChanges (uid)
    Prov->>Hybrid: bindCloudUser(uid)
    Hybrid->>GW: pull(uid)
    par parallel batches
      GW->>FS: get engineNodeCompletions
      GW->>FS: get engineNodeClaims
      GW->>FS: get engineRewardGrants
      GW->>FS: get engineObjectiveCompletions
      GW->>FS: get engineNodeAnnouncements
    end
    FS-->>GW: LedgerEvent[]
    GW-->>Hybrid: combined events
    Hybrid->>Isar: appendEvents (dedup via eventKey)
    Hybrid->>Eng: re-evaluate po merge
    Eng->>CB: reapplyHistoricalCosmetics(ledgerSnapshot)
    CB->>CB: re-emit cosmetics.unlock pro každý cosmetic grant

flows.title: Health Connect refresh (foreground)
flows.summary: Range refresh fitness dat — kroky, kalorie, spánek, váha, aktivity. Používá inclusive UI range + exclusive query end, aby HC API vrátilo poslední den. Při quota erroru se zachová cached state.
flows.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant UI
    participant FP as FitnessProvider
    participant HC as HealthConnectService
    participant HCAPI as Health Connect API
    participant DB as HealthDatabase (Isar)

    UI->>FP: refreshRange(from, to)
    FP->>FP: normalize endExclusive na to plus 1 den
    FP->>HC: getDataInRange(from, endExclusive, types)
    HC->>HCAPI: getHealthDataFromTypes(...)
    alt success
      HCAPI-->>HC: records (může zahrnovat den navíc)
      HC->>HC: filter zpět na inclusive range
      HC-->>FP: filtered records
      FP->>DB: upsert per collection (steps / cals / sleep / weight / activity)
      FP->>DB: update HcMetaRecord.lastSyncedAt
      FP-->>UI: notifyListeners()
    else quota error
      HCAPI--xHC: QuotaExceeded
      HC-->>FP: error
      Note over FP,DB: existující cache zachovaná, lastSyncedAt se NEupdatuje
      FP-->>UI: notifyListeners(error)
    end

flows.title: Kalorické tabulky login + sync
flows.summary: Cookie-based session auth s credentials ve flutter_secure_storage. Pokud session vyprší, transparent re-login + retry.
flows.diagram:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant UI participant KP as KalorickeTabulkyProvider participant KT as KalorickeTabulkyService participant SS as flutter_secure_storage participant API as kaloricketabulky.cz participant DB as KtNutritionDatabase (Isar) UI->>KP: refreshDay(date) KP->>KT: fetchDailyDiary(date) KT->>API: GET /user/diary/{dd.mm.yyyy}/get
(cookie session) alt session OK API-->>KT: 200 + JSON else session expired API--xKT: 401 KT->>SS: read kt_email + kt_pwd_hash SS-->>KT: credentials KT->>API: POST login API-->>KT: 200 + new session cookies KT->>API: retry GET /user/diary/... API-->>KT: 200 + JSON end KT-->>KP: NutritionDayRecord KP->>DB: upsert NutritionDayRecord KP-->>UI: notifyListeners()

flows.title: Coach Log (Bushido) export
flows.summary: Idempotentní týdenní coaching report do Google Sheets. Scan skrytého sloupce Z najednou na začátku, in-memory cache markerů, append nových bloků na konec listu. Manual buňky se nikdy nepřepisují.
flows.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant UI
    participant Prov as BushidoExportProvider
    participant Builder as ExportDataBuilder
    participant Sheets as BushidoSheetsService
    participant GS as Google Sheets API

    UI->>Prov: exportRange(from, to)
    Prov->>Prov: refresh HC + KT pro rozsah
    Prov->>Sheets: read sloupec Z (jedno volání)
    Sheets->>GS: spreadsheets.values.get sloupec Z
    GS-->>Sheets: marker rows
    Sheets-->>Prov: in-memory cache IsoWeek na startRow
    loop pro každý ISO týden v rozsahu
      Prov->>Builder: build(week, HC + KT data)
      Builder-->>Prov: BushidoWeekReport (7 dnů, missing jako null)
      alt blok existuje v cache
        Prov->>Sheets: writeAutoCells (auto sloupce A až H)
      else blok neexistuje
        Prov->>Sheets: appendWeekBlock(week)
        Sheets->>GS: append marker + headers + vzorce
        Sheets-->>Prov: nový startRow → update cache
        Prov->>Sheets: writeAutoCells (auto sloupce A až H)
      end
      Note over Sheets: manual sloupce I až L se NIKDY nezapisují
    end
    Prov->>Sheets: ensureWeekBlock(nextWeek)

flows.title: Factory reset
flows.summary: DevTools action — kompletní wipe lokálního stavu (Isar + Prefs + secure) + (volitelně) Firestore. Po dokončení appka pokračuje jako fresh install.
flows.diagram:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant UI as DevTools UI participant FRS as FactoryResetService participant Isar as 4× Isar DB participant SP as SharedPreferences participant SS as flutter_secure_storage participant Auth as FirebaseAuth participant FS as Firestore UI->>UI: confirm dialog UI->>FRS: reset(scopes) FRS->>Isar: close + delete files
(health / kt / engine / cosmetics) FRS->>SP: clear() — všechny klíče FRS->>SS: delete kt_email + kt_pwd_hash opt deleteCloudData FRS->>FS: batched delete users/{uid}/engine* + ostatní end FRS->>Auth: signOut (Firebase + Google) FRS-->>UI: hotovo Note over UI: appka restartuje do onboardingu
